data.title: HRH the Crown Prince Congratulates Željka Cvijanović on Taking Constitutional Oath as Member of Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, sent a cable of congratulations to Chairwoman of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina Željka Cvijanović on taking the constitutional oath as a member of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
    HRH the Crown Prince extended his sincere congratulations and best wishes for her success and for further progress and advancement for the friendly people of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
    -- SPA
